description: This file defines a controller class for managing the shipping weight extension in the OpenCart admin interface. It handles loading the configuration page, retrieving related geo zones and tax classes, and saving settings via AJAX.

classes.name: Weight
classes.description: Controller class for managing the weight shipping extension settings in the admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles rendering the configuration page for the shipping weight extension, including breadcrumbs, geo zones, tax classes, and other settings.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes AJAX requests to save the shipping weight extension settings, with permission checks and JSON responses.
